candidates.change_summary: Change supportsInterface to always return false for IERC165 (negate previous comparison), flipping whether it reports ERC165 support.
Make supportsInterface only report support for IAccessControl and not defer to super.supportsInterface(interfaceId).
Make supportsInterface unconditionally return true (claims to support every interface ID).
Make supportsInterface unconditionally return false (claims to support no interface ID).
Swap the OR to AND so it reports support only if interfaceId equals IAccessControl AND super supports it (narrower reporting).
